capabilities: Open embedded or tabbed PDFs in an external PDF editor
List saved PDF variants chronologically and hot-swap the embed to any version
Detect versions automatically by timestamp or version-number naming patterns
Scan the vault for duplicate PDF variants and delete older ones
Redirect or strip markdown links when deleting a PDF variant
disambiguation: Not general file version control; it only tracks PDF variants saved by external editors using timestamp or version-number filenames.
extras: Manual installation only: the README instructs copying main.js, manifest.json, and styles.css into .obsidian/plugins. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian's built-in PDF viewer flattens handwriting and offers no way to keep, browse, or switch between multiple saved iterations of the same PDF file.

relations.evidence: It perfectly complements apps like Samsung Notes (on Android) which can export vector-ink PDFs

summary: PDF versioning manager that opens embedded PDFs in external editors and tracks, swaps between, and cleans up multiple saved versions of a PDF.
